title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘forestry and’
part_context: Highlights the resilience and importance of the agricultural sector (19 % of GDP, 53 % of goods exports) but underlines the need to diversify value chains and the benefit of swiftly adopting EU phytosanitary standards; underlines the importance of environmental safeguards in ensuring the green recovery of Ukraine; calls on the Commission to further support Ukraine with the implementation of Environmental Impact Assessment procedures, in particular in the <del>forestry and</del> agriculture sectors, and Strategic Environmental Assessment procedures; calls, furthermore, on the Commission to further support Ukraine in building administrative capacity for the full implementation of the EU environmental *acquis*, including public participation in decision-making, and in aligning its legislation with the Renewable Energy Directive[[8]](#footnote-8), in particular the sustainability criteria for bioenergy;
